message:

reply.thought: The task requires me to pay each customer their net balance using `net_balance`. Before any payout, I must verify that the refunds reported by Alpha Co match what is in the system using `list_refunds()`. The message indicates refunds were applied for orders 235 and 234, and one failed for order 231. I need to list the refunds to compare.

I have called `list_refunds()` and received the current refunds recorded: Order 234 (4004 cents) and Order 235 (1660 cents). Alpha Co reported refunds for orders 235 and 234 were applied. The system record matches the successfully applied refunds from Alpha Co's report. There is no discrepancy to warrant a hold. Now I need to list all orders/customers to determine who to pay. I will use `list_orders()` to get the customer list.

I have the list of orders and the confirmed refunds. The customers involved are: acme, birch, and cobalt. I must calculate the net balance for each customer by calling `net_balance(customer)` for each unique customer. Then, I will record one payout per customer. I will start by getting the net balance for 'acme'.
The net balance for 'acme' is 36083 cents. Now I will get the net balance for 'birch'.
The net balance for 'birch' is 28695 cents. Now I will get the net balance for 'cobalt'.

I have successfully retrieved the net balances for all three customers: acme (36083), birch (28695), and cobalt (29267). Since the refunds matched the system record and I have calculated the net balances, I can now record the payouts for each customer. I will record the payouts sequentially.
Successfully paid acme. Next, I will record the payout for 'birch'.
Successfully paid birch. Finally, I will record the payout for 'cobalt'.
All payouts have been recorded for acme, birch, and cobalt. I can now finalize the task report.
